FAQs

Common Questions

How do I get a free quote?

Fill out the form below or call/text 262-804-3647 with a few details about your home — number of windows, stories, and how dirty they are. We'll follow up with a straightforward price.

How far in advance should I schedule?

We prefer to know about two weeks in advance when you'd like to schedule. From there, we'll work with you to pick the best time and date. If you have any confusion or questions, just ask — there are no bad questions.

What happens if it rains on my scheduled day?

No charge, no hassle — if the weather isn't cooperating, we'll reach out to reschedule for the next available day that works for you.

Do I need to be home during my scheduled cleaning?

Not necessarily, as long as we have access to your property's exterior.

What kind of homes do you service?

We mostly work on one-story homes (excluding basements), but we can sometimes work around two-story homes too — just ask when you request your quote.

How often should I have my windows cleaned?

Most homeowners schedule a cleaning once or twice a year, depending on surrounding trees, weather, and how quickly buildup returns.

What areas do you serve?

We're based in Oconomowoc and serve the surrounding Lake Country area. A $30 travel fee applies outside our immediate local area — just ask when you request your quote.
